summary: Fixed on main-debug (89e2f98e2): compiling a lib-target hull shader whose groupshared use is only in the patch-constant function now correctly fails validation, naming the patch-constant function (HSPatch). Release-binary bisection: reproduces on every stable release v1.4.1907-v1.9.2602.24, fixed starting v1.9.2607. PR 5749 (reporter's own proposed fix) was closed unmerged by an inactivity sweep; the shipped fix instead appears to be an incidental effect of PR 8140 (GroupSharedLimit for Mesh/Amp/Node shaders), which added the missing IsPatchConstantShader check to the same validation loop -- strong but not build-confirmed attribution, since its 2026-02-13 merge predates the still-reproducing v1.9.2602.24 release build.
title: Groupshared memory used through patch constant function allowed in hull shaders
